refusal.CLOSED: The project is closed: reopen it before changing it.
refusal.MOVE: The project cannot move to this status from the one it is in.
refusal.PARTY_FIXED: A project’s outside company is chosen when it is made and never changes.
refusal.PARTY_BLOCKED: This company is blocked or archived: a new project cannot be shared with it.
refusal.NOT_OUTSIDE: A project is shared with a customer, a brand, a supplier or a subcontractor, or with nobody outside.
refusal.LEAD: A project is led by an active office person who may read it.
refusal.SEASON: This season is not a season of the project’s company.
refusal.LINK_TYPE: A project links styles, sample rounds, quotes, orders, purchase and subcontract orders, changes, certificates, requests, shipments and measurement profiles.
refusal.LINK_COMPANY: This record belongs to another company of the group: a project links records of its own company only.
refusal.LINK_PARTY: This record belongs to another outside company: it cannot join this project. A project links records of its own outside company, or of none.
refusal.LINK_OFFICE_ONLY: This project is office-only: it links only records that belong to no outside company.
refusal.ALREADY_LINKED: This record is linked to the project already.
refusal.MEMBER_NOT_READER: This person cannot read this project: only someone who may see it can be added.
refusal.MEMBER_OFFICE_ONLY: The project is office-only: people of an outside company cannot be its members.
refusal.MEMBER_OTHER_PARTY: Only portal people of the project’s outside company can be added.
refusal.MEMBER_LEAD: The lead stays in the project: pick a new lead first.
refusal.MEMBER_REMOVE: Only the project’s lead, or someone who manages projects, removes a colleague; anyone may leave by themselves.
refusal.NO_PARTY_REQUEST: The request has no customer yet: match it to its customer first (a project’s outside company never changes afterwards).
refusal.other: The project cannot be changed this way.

problem.unavailable: The service does not answer right now. Try again in a moment.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not open the projects of this company.
problem.notFound: Project not found: it no longer exists, or it is not one you may open.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again.
problem.contract: The answer was not what this page expects: reload the page.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time: wait a moment.
problem.stale: Someone changed the project meanwhile: it was read again; look and try again.
problem.writeForbidden: Your role cannot do this on this project.
problem.stepUp: A fresh authenticator code is needed.

held.offline: You are offline: try again when the network is back.
held.closed: The project is closed: reopen it before changing it.

common.openToOffice: Everyone in the company who reads threads can open this project.

list.intro: A project groups work on several styles, samples and orders, or work that has no record yet. About one record, write in its thread.
list.countMore: The first {count} projects: narrow the filters to see them all
list.emptyBody: A project groups work on several styles, samples and orders, or work with no record yet.
list.foot: A closed project leaves My projects but stays in Closed and in search.
list.footMore: At most 1,000 projects are read: narrow the filters to find an older one.

hint.mine: The open projects you are in: you lead them, made them, were added or follow them
hint.active: Every active project you may open
hint.party: The active projects in order of their outside company; office-only ones last
hint.closed: The closed projects, with their outcome

bulk.closeHeld: A project is closed one at a time, on its page: each close asks its own outcome (done or stopped) and one line.
bulk.skippedClosed_one: {count} skipped: it is closed (reopen it on its page)
bulk.skippedClosed_other: {count} skipped: they are closed (reopen each on its page)
bulk.skippedRefused_one: {count} skipped: your role cannot change it, or someone changed it meanwhile
bulk.skippedRefused_other: {count} skipped: your role cannot change them, or someone changed them meanwhile

colleague.intro: The colleagues offered are the ones who may read the first project picked and are not in it yet. Anyone who cannot read another of the projects is skipped, and counted. The person added is told.
colleague.none: Everyone who may see this project is in it already.

noAccess.title: You cannot open projects
noAccess.body: Projects open with the right to read threads. Ask whoever manages the roles.

new.title: New project
new.rule: A project is for work on several styles, samples or orders, or work with no record yet. About one order? Write on that order.
new.namePlaceholder: For example: FW27 airbag jacket line
new.nameHint: One line: what the office calls it.
new.nameTooLong: The name is at most {count} characters.
new.setOnceParty: Only {name} and our team will be in this project. This cannot be changed later.
new.setOnceOffice: Office only: our team only. No outside company can be added later.
new.partiesNoRight: Your role does not list customers and suppliers: this project will be office only.
new.leadHint: You lead it. Change the lead on the project page once it is made.
new.targetHint: When it should be done: its lead is nudged if it passes quietly.
new.seasonHint: Optional: an open season of the company.
new.noSeasons: The company has no open seasons.
new.goalHint: Optional: a paragraph on what it should achieve. It stays in the office, never with an outside company.
new.goalCharacters: The goal holds characters that cannot be saved.
new.goalTooLong: The goal is at most {count} characters.
new.noCompany: Open a company first: a project belongs to one company.
new.similar: An active project with a similar name exists: {project}
new.similarParty: An active project with a similar name exists for {name}: {project}
